pages.text: Pads face the way you look when you place them and work on the **2-block box in front of their face**. They take RF on every other side, so put a **Power Terminal** chassis or any RF source behind them. Using a pad with a charged RF item moves that item's energy into the pad.

A **Charge Pad** charges RF items in the inventories and armor of players standing in front of it, and single RF items lying there. It splits its output evenly between them. A **Health Pad** heals hurt creatures by half a heart at a time. That costs **192,000 RF per half heart**, so plan your power.
